conventions.convention: Natural units c = ℏ = 1, metric diag(-1,1,1,1), on-shell momenta p_j² = -m², and s + t + u = 4m² are used.
The interaction is +C₈(μ*) (∂μφ ∂^μφ)²/Λ⁴, with dimensionless real C₈ in a fixed local representative. No invariance of C₈ under general changes of representative is asserted.
The centered variable is v = s - 2m², the positive threshold is ν₀ = 2m², B is crossing-even after the specified paired pole subtraction, and c₁ = B''(0)/2!.

Compact cut-bank continuity, uniform B(w) = o(|w|²), vanishing threshold arcs, finite improper bank integrals, and a finite nonnegative absorptive moment are supplied admissibility assumptions. The endpoint assignment ρ(ν₀) = 0 asserts no threshold limit.
Exact matching means c₁ = 4C₈(μ*)/Λ⁴ + Δ_match. The real remainder has mass dimension -4 and retains every other contribution; setting it to zero requires an additional exact matching condition.
The example takes Λ = 4m and Δ_match = 0. Passing C₈ ≥ 0 is only passing a necessary inequality, including its zero boundary, and establishes no amplitude existence.

load_bearing.statement: A gapped identical-real-scalar channel supplies the specified crossing-even, real-analytic, pole-subtracted amplitude B, its analytic and spectral admissibility conditions, a fixed dimension-eight local representative, and the exact identity c₁ = 4C₈(μ*)/Λ⁴ + Δ_match. These data construct neither an amplitude nor a physical realization.

Under the stated gapped-channel analyticity, crossing, pole-subtraction, growth, spectral, boundary-integral and exact matching hypotheses, C₈(μ*) + (Λ⁴/4)Δ_match ≥ 0. If additionally Δ_match = 0, then C₈(μ*) ≥ 0. This is only a necessary constraint on the specified matched combination.
